reuse.why: Works inside the shared getNextDate, but does not introduce or use a shared weekend-rule definition, so the other weekend-handling paths (getUpcomingDates, schedule-template) are not reached.

duplication.why: The new loop itself duplicates nothing, but adds a second weekend decision inside getNextDate alongside the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend call.

placement.why: shared/schedules.ts is the right module, but the rule is buried in getNextDate instead of in a weekend-handling function every caller uses.

scope.why: One hunk in getNextDate plus tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and commented, but the daily-skip rule now applies only to getNextDate callers while getUpcomingDates and the budget schedule template still move daily weekend occurrences, an inconsistency a maintainer has to know about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is circumvented; the change sits in the shared next-date function.

one_place.where: Only shared/schedules.ts getNextDate skips daily weekends; schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts still call getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly and shift daily weekend occurrences.
